'''Dengar876 Tuskens raid along side Ur'Ru'r and RR'uruurrr!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dengar876]]
* '''Published:''' 21 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 MKOS Dengar876 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A Tusken Raider Deck using My kind of Scum

The published list has 57 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck has a simple strategy.

Use Jabba's palace's text to pull audience chamber and then use audience chamber's text to pull Jabba, add 1 to tusken foreit. Bantha Fodler lets you pull Taym Dren-garen, any Tusken Raider, or any Bantha. Use banthas at every site if you can, have about 2 tusken raiders per site, passengers on the banthas, it is a creature vehicle and unexclosed so they should still add power and ability, (tell me if i'm wrong). The Bantha Herd will add 1 battle destiny at whatever site it is at. Use Kithaba against any jedi. Krayt Dragon Bones is great when Taym Dren-garen is at audience chamber you can ignore results at any time.

You can use Death Mark and Destroyed Homestead to hurt space decks, and throw your tusken raiders on Den of Thieves to cancel their drains! When they least expect it throw Executer and Fett in Slave One to slaughter a starship!

Order to pull sites if you have a choice:

1 Tatooine: Jundland Waste

2 Tatooine: Lar's Moisture Farm

3 Tatooine: Krayt Dragon Pass

4 Tatooine: Tusken Canyon

Making Tusken's the Best

If you can get Taym Dren-garen and Jabba at audience chamber, that will add 1 power to each tusken raider, and +3 forfeit

With Chall Bekan at the same or adjecent site, aliens deploy -1

With a Bantha Tusken Raiders are +1 power at same site, URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha +2 power/Tusken Raider

Skum and Villany -1 deploy for aliens

In total, if you have all the following down, Tusken Raiders will be 4 power (5 if with URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha)deploy for free 1 ablility and forfeit =5 this is also excluding extra destiny!
